item.name: 03 Categories
item.description: Self-contained: logs in the seeded admin, registers a fresh customer for the 403 checks and uses a unique category name per run (Date.now()). No email needed. Deletes what it created. Needs: API running, admin seeded (npm run seed:admin), RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=false.

exec: pm.test('status is 200 (run npm run seed:admin first)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
// A fresh customer. Register returns a token right away; no email is needed for a 403 check
// A unique name per run, so the collection can run again and again
pm.test('slug is generated from the name', () => pm.expect(category.slug).to.eql(pm.environment.get('categoryName').toLowerCase().replace(/ /g, '-')));
pm.test('explains why', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('A category with this name already exists'));
pm.test('two levels only', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Only two category levels are allowed'));
pm.test('contains our category and its child', () => { pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.environment.get('categoryId')); pm.expect(ids).to.include(pm.environment.get('childCategoryId')); });

item.name: 04 Products & Uploads
item.description: Self-contained: logs in the seeded admin, registers a customer (for the 403 checks), creates its own category and three products (one inactive), then exercises filters, search, sorting, pagination, stock, image removal and the upload guards, and finally deletes everything it created. Cloudinary keys are NOT needed: the upload requests check the 400/401/403 paths. Needs: API running, admin seeded (npm run seed:admin), RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED=false.
